record.question: Target haemoglobin level recommended during erythropoietin therapy in CKD is:
record.explanation: Answer C: 10-11.5 g/dL. KDIGO 2026 recommends targeting Hb below 11.5 g/dL in adults receiving ESAs. Of the listed intervals, 10–11.5 g/dL is the best fit, but the guideline does not prescribe a universal 10 g/dL lower target. Reference: https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/KDIGO-2026-Anemia-in-CKD-Guideline.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
